# DPA b995 — original Actions evidence audit

**The portable campaign failed with a TEST_FLAW; DPA owner9 + HTTP8 have direct passing behavior evidence on b995.** This does not establish scoped unit admission or full migration acceptance.

Exact subject `b9953fced2714c45b70ef47b4ffb42a261c190db`, tree `9835448cfd6c24b87536c0d3aa945bb00abfd8f2`, fixed U `1440bb1771372334bea23d7642bb52deb7db1845`. Original runtime41548670140 and source41548670260, attempt1. At seal 2026-11-03T00:00:45Z, Linux job125630448147 is completed/failure; macOS125630448286 remains queued. The overall runtime API therefore remains queued/null, not a completed successful workflow. Source is completed/success.

## Direct failure and preserved positives

Early artifact13189872205 has SHA256 `7b22182a3e1073d8956ab67641ca9566d356b7d888dacac215f68cd3c28f6eea`, 181811bytes. All99 distinct source hashes match the immutable tree; all18 command/required-name recipes match. Seventeen cases pass. The integration command exits101 (capture0) solely because `channel_gateway_write_and_admin_credentials_persist_through_reopen` compares a newly opened owner's sealed proof to a former owner's proof at line477. Public device/role/scope projections match; DPA deliberately binds proof equality to issuer allocation. Existing mutation, exact credential/metadata bytes, unrelated state and two real reopen assertions precede the failure.

Classification: TEST_FLAW. Preserve production proof equality and old valid behavior assertions; repair the oracle to assert fresh authenticated projections and distinct owner proof after a durable runner decision, then focused review and exact repaired-H Actions. Never rerun unchanged b995 to choose green. `failure-handoff.json` preserves the causal evidence.

DPA owner9, HTTP8, DPR20 and DJC8 have complete exact commands, zero cargo/capture exits, every source test name exactly once, one exact success summary, zero failed/ignored/measured/filtered and matching target banners. Original logs and independent recipe/source/hash checks are in `receipt-audit.json`. DPA owner log SHA256 `5d5a9d7a10fc0babd520fa3b62b3a744a821c81bd9f3573a30bd018878f583a8`; HTTP log `0cffd2869a50c614b237e7523f92ee0849ed6bcba794ad25ec6bf7efe09a2415`.

The first integration case is not approved even though individual targets passed. Automation admission/composed Memory, App62/127commands, DPS7 and palette-consumer steps were skipped after its failure. The final LPG step has direct Host9+43, Coordinator58+1 and actual App3 successes, each with zero Cargo/capture exits and exact log/source hashes. Its overall receipt is failed-or-incomplete solely because the required reused-MCP Automation receipt/log is absent after that producer was skipped. Classification: BLOCKED_BY_PRIOR_TEST_FLAW. Actual App test-binary compilation is established; App62 and DPS7 remain unexecuted.

## Source and desktop evidence

Source completed/success. Original source artifact13189817068, ZIP SHA256 `be0f061738229cf3c9340f432f8d601993b463a831251522342a094e6f3bc1ff`, binds all22 inputs. Original logs show33 source-review and21 materialization tests, tracked-source G01 and structural G02 success. Its explicit scope excludes dependency/LFS closure and unit admission; G02final not-run, all eight completion flags false.

Renderer artifact13190296070, ZIP SHA256 `e774d3cb4b07ce7b41922d8d02c528ef4ece3c00fd451111753ec9e0c922f2eb`, contains115/115 TAP tests with zero fail/cancel/skip/todo,14 exact-tree input hashes and all11 router positives once. Actual decoded job125630448208 log matches checkout/build/test commands. This grants no native Rust/App or physical-service compatibility credit.

Only read-only API/Git/source inspection, original artifact extraction and byte/evidence auditing performed; no local/htch product validation or dispatch/rerun/cancel. Reviewer effort classified xhigh by the parent; actual launch fork_turns=all inherited model/effort without override or reported fallback. All full-scope gates and real device/provider/platform acceptance remain open.

## Sealed terminal evidence

Final Linux artifact13189598787: 209450bytes, ZIP SHA256 `ae52aa9258c3bbf26a17a7a5596f9941ca2a5c2a834976293950246eb4586247`. Its portable receipt SHA256 is `95b91c0820093a5298115d3fe4d9e59b1743abe6365b000c5795e1ae5447ee6a`; original early/final portable evidence is byte-identical. LPG receipt SHA256 `99ea741f7a606766a161844f63f4a31b097d0305e42ca28a63f894abb28852db`; all28 before/after inputs match the frozen tree, all three actual commands match their recipe, and reused-MCP has explicit ENOENT with no command or exit outcome. Full decoded Linux job log SHA256 `9420dac890196af7730b80880565ed52178c551f08081c6d82640da0417ef21a` (1732491bytes).

Five original ZIP archives, API byte lengths/digests and exact source SHAs match; all80 extracted member occurrences match their ZIP bytes. No archive member or prior-H run is counted twice as a test. Media receipt `66cb3153084033b3e68a5a0ba189752554a99d0e3e95b4c6bc892305abc0e9b6` has26 exact inputs, three zero-exit commands/captures and71+1+2 raw positives, including all39 required names and three deadline controls. Native-path checked custody evidence retains its raw child/ignored summaries rather than manufacturing an aggregate count. The distinct restore lane has29 ordinary positives with2 intentionally ignored mount controls; those two run separately as actual private mount-namespace cases with1/1 each. These limited results establish no complete platform or real-service acceptance.

DPA source tests may retain their approved b995 execution evidence, but **DPA unit verified is false** pending scoped authority/coverage and the remaining affected campaign. Source structural success explicitly cannot stand in for that admission. The thirteen macOS capture controls have no execution credit while that job is queued. Eight global completion flags remain false.

The parent reported durable DPA010 and a one-file oracle repair entering fresh focused review. This audit contains no recovery-H result and did not execute, dispatch or rerun any job. Reports and underlying evidence are frozen by `dpa-b995/evidence-seal.json`; a new H must use its own evidence paths.
